reading.title: Culture shock（Heidi 的香港日記）
reading.intro: Heidi 是來自德國的學生。閱讀她的日記，了解她初到香港經歷的文化差異：

paragraphs.text:
Tuesday 4th April, 20XX — Arrival in Hong Kong（到達香港）
It is my first day in Hong Kong. Mrs Tam and Mr Tam met me at Hong Kong International Airport. They took me to my new 'home'. On the way, I saw many high-rises. Hong Kong looks so different from Hof — in Hof, there are not any high-rises but only small houses.
I cannot understand what the people say because they speak Cantonese. It sounds so different from German or English. I must try to learn it!
paragraphs.translation:
20XX 年 4 月 4 日 星期二 — 到達香港
這是我在香港的第一天。Tam 太太和 Tam 先生在香港國際機場接我。他們帶我去我的新「家」。途中，我看到很多高樓大廈。香港看起來和 Hof 很不一樣——在 Hof，沒有任何高樓大廈，只有小房子。
我聽不懂人們說的話，因為他們說粵語。它聽起來和德語或英語很不同。我一定要試著學！

pairs.zh: 看起來和 Hof 很不一樣

pairs.en: I must try to learn it

sentences: Tuesday 4th April, 20XX — Arrival in Hong Kong

They took me to my new 'home'.
On the way, I saw many high-rises.
Hong Kong looks so different from Hof — in Hof, there are not any high-rises but only small houses.
I cannot understand what the people say because they speak Cantonese.
It sounds so different from German or English.
I must try to learn it!
translation_sentences: 20XX 年 4 月 4 日 星期二 — 到達香港

他們帶我去我的新「家」。
途中，我看到很多高樓大廈。
香港看起來和 Hof 很不一樣——在 Hof，沒有任何高樓大廈，只有小房子。
我聽不懂人們說的話，因為他們說粵語。
它聽起來和德語或英語很不同。
我一定要試著學！

paragraphs.text:
Sunday 9th April, 20XX — First Sunday in Hong Kong（在香港的第一個星期日）
After breakfast, Mrs Tam took me to a shopping centre. I was amazed and surprised! In Germany, shops and shopping centres do not open on Sundays. Then we went to a park. There was a lawn and I wanted to play there. 'Don't step on the grass!' Mrs Tam stopped me. In Germany, I can walk and play on the grass in the park. However, it is not allowed in Hong Kong!
In the afternoon, Mrs Tam took me to a temple. There was smoke from the joss sticks everywhere. People in Hong Kong have different religions. As in Germany, some people are Christians and they go to church. But in Hong Kong, there are also Buddhists and Taoists.
paragraphs.translation:
20XX 年 4 月 9 日 星期日 — 在香港的第一個星期日
早餐後，Tam 太太帶我去購物中心。我很驚訝！在德國，商店和購物中心星期日不營業。然後我們去了公園。那裡有一片草坪，我想在上面玩。「不要踩草地！」Tam 太太阻止了我。在德國，我可以在公園的草地上走和玩。但是，在香港是不允許的！
下午，Tam 太太帶我去了一間寺廟。到處都是香火煙霧。香港人有不同的宗教。和德國一樣，有些人是基督徒，他們去教堂。但在香港，也有佛教徒和道教徒。

paragraphs.text:
Wednesday 12th April, 20XX — First day at school（上學第一天）
The streets all seemed confusing, so Mrs Tam walked to school with me. My new friends were very nice. We played hide-and-seek and hopscotch — the same games I always play in Germany!
Chinese people really eat a lot of rice! Today, I had congee (a thick soup of rice) for breakfast, fried rice for lunch, and pork and vegetables with rice for dinner! Chinese food is tasty, but I miss bread and pumpkin soup!
paragraphs.translation:
20XX 年 4 月 12 日 星期三 — 上學第一天
街道看起來都很亂，所以 Tam 太太陪我走到學校。我的新朋友們都很好。我們玩捉迷藏和跳房子——這是我在德國一直玩的相同遊戲！
中國人真的很愛吃米飯！今天，我早餐吃了粥（一種濃稠的米湯），午餐吃了炒飯，晚餐吃了豬肉、蔬菜配米飯！中國菜很好吃，但我想念麵包和南瓜湯！

listening.title: 聆聽練習：Heidi 和 Mr Tam 的星期六
listening.description: 今天是星期六，Heidi 和 Mr Tam 一起外出。聆聽對話，選出最佳答案：

script.title: A Saturday with Mr Tam（和 Tam 先生的星期六）
script.text: It's Saturday today. Heidi goes out with Mr Tam. They are walking in a park. There are many flowers and trees. Mr Tam: Heidi, do you like chocolate? We have chocolate eggs in Hong Kong. Heidi: Yes! In Germany, our chocolate eggs are sweeter. Mr Tam: Can you sing 'Brother John'? Heidi: Yes, I can sing it in German and in Cantonese now! Mr Tam: I have a board game called 'Don't Get Angry'. It is from Germany. Heidi: In Germany, I play 'Don't Get Angry' with my family! What game is this? Mr Tam: It's Chinese checkers. I'm going to teach you today. Heidi: Great! I want to learn Chinese checkers. Mr Tam: Do you like reading? Heidi: Yes! I want to read English comic books. Mr Tam: Let's go to the bookshop after lunch!
script.zh:
今天是星期六。Heidi 和 Mr Tam 一起外出。
他們正在公園裡散步。那裡有很多花和樹。
Tam 先生：Heidi，你喜歡巧克力嗎？在香港我們有巧克力蛋。
Heidi：喜歡！在德國，我們的巧克力蛋更甜。
Tam 先生：你會唱《兩隻老虎》嗎？
Heidi：會，我現在可以用德語和粵語唱！
Tam 先生：我有一個叫「別生氣」的棋盤遊戲。它來自德國。
Heidi：在德國，我和家人玩「別生氣」！這是甚麼遊戲？
Tam 先生：這是中國跳棋。我今天教你玩。
Heidi：太好了！我想學中國跳棋。
Tam 先生：你喜歡閱讀嗎？
Heidi：喜歡！我想讀英文漫畫書。
Tam 先生：午餐後我們去書店吧！

questions.text: 1. Where are Heidi and Mr Tam?

textType.title: Text Type: Personal Letters（私人書信）
textType.description: 私人書信（personal letter）是寫給家人或朋友的信，包含我們的經歷、意見和感受。一封書信包括日期（Date）、稱呼（Salutation）、正文（Body）、結尾（Closing）和簽名（Signature）：

model.title: Heidi's letter to Grandma（Heidi 給祖母的信）
model.body:
14th June, 20XX
Dear Grandma,
I have learned a lot about the local culture in Hong Kong. People do not eat as many potatoes or as much bread as we do. People here have different religions, too — there are Buddhists, Taoists, Muslims ...
I have seen a few ceremonies where people wear traditional Chinese costumes. My favourite costume is the cheongsam. It is very beautiful. You would look great in one, Granny!
Take care,
Heidi
model.zh:
20XX 年 6 月 14 日
親愛的祖母：
我在香港學到了很多關於本地文化的事。這裡的人不像我們吃那麼多馬鈴薯或那麼多麵包。這裡的人也有不同的宗教——有佛教徒、道教徒、穆斯林……
我見過幾場人們穿傳統中國服飾的儀式。我最喜歡的服飾是旗袍。它非常漂亮。您穿一件一定很好看，奶奶！
保重，
Heidi
sentences: 14th June, 20XX
Dear Grandma,
I have learned a lot about the local culture in Hong Kong.

My favourite costume is the cheongsam.

You would look great in one, Granny!
Take care,

questions.text: 1. In which part of the letter can you read about Hong Kong culture?
questions.explanation: 正文（body）包含信的主要內容，談到香港文化的部分在正文，所以選 b。

questions.text: 2. Which of the following sentences is NOT true?

options.text: a. Heidi likes cheongsams.（Heidi 喜歡旗袍）
b. Grandma has a cheongsam.（祖母有一件旗袍）
c. Heidi thinks cheongsams are beautiful.（Heidi 覺得旗袍漂亮）
d. The cheongsam is a Chinese costume.（旗袍是中國服飾）

questions.explanation: 信中說 You would look great in one, Granny（您穿一定好看）——是建議祖母穿，不是說她已有旗袍，所以 b 不正確。

grammar.title: 比較：the same / similar / different ＋ could / couldn't（過去的能）

examples.en: We played the same games I always play in Germany.
examples.zh: 我們玩了我一直在德國玩的相同遊戲。（the same 相同的）

examples.en: Ting-ting's and Fei-fei's cheongsams are similar.
examples.zh: 婷婷和飛飛的旗袍很相似。（similar 相似的）

examples.en: Hong Kong looks so different from Hof.
examples.zh: 香港看起來和 Hof 很不一樣。（different from 和…不同）

examples.en: Could you cook Chinese food at first? No, I couldn't.
examples.zh: 一開始你會煮中國菜嗎？不，我不會。（could/couldn't 表示過去的能）

examples.en: Could you tell me the way to the MTR station? Sure. Walk across the footbridge.
examples.zh: 你能告訴我去地鐵站的路嗎？當然可以。走過行人天橋。（could you 表示請求）

practice.intro: 根據 Unit 6（Culture shock）內容完成以下練習題：

readingComp.title: 練習 1：閱讀理解判斷與選擇
readingComp.description: 根據 Heidi 的日記，選擇最佳答案：

questions.text: 1. What is Heidi's home town in Germany?
questions.explanation: 日記說 Hong Kong looks so different from Hof，所以 Heidi 的家鄉是 Hof。

questions.text: 2. Find a word in the diary which means 'tall buildings'.
questions.explanation: high-rises（高樓大廈）就是 tall buildings。

questions.text: 3. Why couldn't Heidi understand people in Hong Kong?
questions.explanation: 日記說 I cannot understand what the people say because they speak Cantonese。

questions.text: 4. What did Heidi eat for breakfast on 12th April?

options.text: c. bread and pumpkin soup（麵包和南瓜湯）
d. pork and vegetables（豬肉和蔬菜）

questions.explanation: 日記說 I had congee for breakfast, fried rice for lunch, and pork and vegetables with rice for dinner。

questions.text: 5. What is NOT allowed in Hong Kong parks according to the diary?

options.text: a. walking on the paths（在小路上走）
b. playing on the grass（在草地上玩）

questions.explanation: Mrs Tam 說 Don't step on the grass! 在香港公園的草地上玩是不允許的，所以選 b。

readingQA.title: 練習 2：閱讀理解問答題
readingQA.description: 用完整的句子回答下列問題：

questions.q: 1. Do you think Heidi likes the things in Hong Kong? Give two examples.（你覺得 Heidi 喜歡香港的事物嗎？舉兩個例子。）
questions.a: Yes. She likes playing hide-and-seek with her new friends and she thinks Chinese food is tasty.
questions.zh: 喜歡。她喜歡和新朋友玩捉迷藏，而且覺得中國菜很好吃。
questions.explanation: 日記說 My new friends were very nice... Chinese food is tasty。

questions.q: 2. Do you want to study in a foreign country? Why or why not?（你想在外國留學嗎？為甚麼？）
questions.a: Yes, I do. I want to learn a new language and make new friends.
questions.zh: 想。我想學新語言和認識新朋友。
questions.explanation: 開放題，說出你的想法和理由即可。

questions.q: 3. What games did Heidi play at school?（Heidi 在學校玩甚麼遊戲？）
questions.explanation: 日記說 We played hide-and-seek and hopscotch — the same games I always play in Germany!

wordBank.title: 練習 3：Words to learn 分類填空
wordBank.description: 用所給詞彙填空（傳統服飾／食物／建築／語言）：

items.prompt: Traditional costume（傳統服飾）: 旗袍
Traditional costume（傳統服飾）: 和服

discussion.title: 練習 4：Speaking 比較服飾＋角色扮演
discussion.description: 看看國際時裝秀的圖片，和同學比較服飾；再和同學扮演 Heidi 和 Steve，談談初到香港時不會做的事：
questions: Nana's and Kana's kimonos are the same.（Nana 和 Kana 的和服是一樣的。）
Their getas are similar.（他們的木屐很相似。）
But their fans are different.（但他們的扇子不同。）
Write about Ting-ting's and Fei-fei's costumes: Ting-ting's and Fei-fei's cheongsams are similar. But their hats are different.（寫寫婷婷和飛飛的服飾：她們的旗袍很相似，但帽子不同。）
Steve: Could you cook Chinese food at first?（Steve：一開始你會煮中國菜嗎？）
Heidi: No, I couldn't. But I can make dumplings now!（Heidi：不，我不會。但我現在會包餃子！）

First arrived in Hong Kong: couldn't cook Chinese food, couldn't find the right bus to school, couldn't play Chinese checkers, couldn't use chopsticks to eat, couldn't speak Cantonese, couldn't order food in Cantonese.（初到香港時：不會煮中國菜、找不到對的校巴、不會玩中國跳棋、不會用筷子吃飯、不會說粵語、不會用粵語點餐。）

sections.title: 詞彙題：文化詞彙（每題 1 分）

questions.text: 1. ______ are tall buildings.
questions.explanation: high-rises（高樓大廈）是 tall buildings。

questions.text: 2. A ______ is a thick soup of rice.
questions.explanation: congee（粥）是濃稠的米湯。

questions.text: 3. People in Hong Kong speak ______.
questions.explanation: 香港人說粵語（Cantonese）。

questions.text: 4. A ______ is a traditional Chinese costume.
questions.explanation: 旗袍（cheongsam）是傳統中國服飾。

questions.text: 5. Buddhists and Taoists are people who have different ______.
questions.explanation: 佛教徒和道教徒信仰不同宗教（religions）。

sections.title: 文法題：比較與 could（每題 1 分）

questions.text: 1. We played ______ games I always play in Germany.
questions.explanation: the same games（相同的遊戲）。

questions.text: 2. Hong Kong looks so different ______ Hof.
questions.explanation: different from（和…不同）。

questions.text: 3. ______ you cook Chinese food at first? No, I ______.
questions.explanation: at first（一開始）是過去，用 could / couldn't。

questions.text: 4. Nana's and Kana's kimonos are ______. They are exactly the same.
questions.explanation: 完全一樣用 the same。

questions.text: 5. Ting-ting's and Fei-fei's cheongsams are ______. They look alike but not exactly the same.
questions.explanation: 相似但不完全相同用 similar。

questions.text: 1. Where is Heidi from?
questions.explanation: Heidi 是來自德國的學生（a student from Germany）。

questions.text: 2. In Germany, shops and shopping centres do not open on ______.
questions.explanation: In Germany, shops and shopping centres do not open on Sundays（星期日）。

questions.text: 3. Why did Mrs Tam stop Heidi on the lawn?

options.text: B. Heidi was late for school.
C. Stepping on the grass is not allowed in Hong Kong.

questions.explanation: 在香港不允許踩草地（it is not allowed in Hong Kong）。

questions.text: 4. What did Heidi have for lunch on 12th April?
questions.explanation: I had congee for breakfast, fried rice for lunch...

questions.text: 5. What is Heidi's favourite Chinese costume in her letter?
questions.explanation: 信中說 My favourite costume is the cheongsam（旗袍）。

learningPoints.title: 4B Unit 6：Culture shock（文化衝擊）
goals: 能閱讀日記並理解文化差異
能認識文化詞彙（cheongsam, kimono, congee 等）
能運用 the same / similar / different 作比較
能運用 could / couldn't 談論過去的能
能認識私人書信（Personal Letter）結構
